¹ Reported as “Revenue”. ² Reported as “Net Loss Attributable to the Common Shareholders”. ³ Reported as “loss per common share - basic and diluted”.
Project Development: Pecos UltraClean Refining FEL-2 completed; modular 60k bpd design with the first 30k bpd permit issued and an 18-month build plan.
Product Focus: Targeting Ultra Fuel®, an ultra-low sulfur diesel intended to cut criteria pollutant emissions by about 95% versus traditional Gulf Coast refineries.
Integrated Hydrogen Strategy: A blue hydrogen/reformer plan is intended to supply refinery fuel gas and enable turbines to run up to 75% hydrogen, targeting near-zero refinery CO2.
Power & Offtake Plans: Trans Permian Energy design aims to convert Permian gas to power and capture CO2 for sale, leveraging ERCOT Far West dispatch potential.
